tasks.title: The Gathering of the Council of Magical Creatures
tasks.description: Attend a briefing to discuss the recent surge in unicorn poaching incidents and decide on the increase of protective wards in enchanted forests.

tasks.title: The Alchemical Approval
tasks.description: Approve the new regulations for potion-making licenses, focusing on the restriction of volatile ingredients in student potion classes based on Professor Morgana's recommendations.

tasks.title: The Transport Tapestry
tasks.description: Meet with the Department of Magical Transportation to finalize the approval for a new Floo Network expansion linking remote wizarding villages to major magical cities.

tasks.title: The Shield of Protection
tasks.description: Oversee enchantment upgrades for the Ministry’s Defense Wards due to reports of weakening in certain areas.

tasks.title: The Scroll of Enlightenment
tasks.description: Review and sign off on the Magical Education Reform Bill, ensuring non-traditional magic forms are included in the curriculum.

tasks.title: The Council of Defenders
tasks.description: Hold a closed-door session with the Auror Command to discuss the threat from rogue magical factions and coordinate a response plan.

tasks.title: The Timekeeper's Review
tasks.description: Inspect the progress of the Time-Turner Research Unit in stabilizing safe time travel spells, addressing issues with wizards disappearing unexpectedly.

tasks.title: The Feast of Alliances
tasks.description: Host a diplomatic luncheon with the visiting delegation from the Enchanted Isles to strengthen alliances and negotiate safe exchanges of rare magical artifacts.

tasks.title: The Veela Sanctuary Decree
tasks.description: Sign off on the relocation order for the Veela community, ensuring they have alternative sanctuary locations prepared by the Department of Magical Creatures.

tasks.title: The Report of Innovation
tasks.description: Receive a progress report from the Spell Innovation Bureau on the development of new counter-curses for dark spell variants in the northern territories.
